title: From a Flower Basket to a Seat
summary: A walk through the Street Corner lobby: concierge Donna and her 30-question verified press bank, six concentric rings of exactly 1,108 seats under an atomic booking lock, guest 1,109 routed to the live stream, and Blossom's 18 numbered flower-basket stands.
